{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/tests/mb_split_empty_match.phpt","function":"<global>","line":10,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_ereg('(?:()|())*\\2', '');","note":"The attacker supplies the exact style of pattern referenced by the Oniguruma compile-time option comment: an empty repeat with captures and a backreference."},

{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler classifies the zero-width quantified body using the memory-aware helper protected by the feature macro."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"NODE_BAG/BAG_MEMORY","code":"case BAG_MEMORY: return BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM;","note":"The capture container is marked as empty-memory, producing the dangerous classification the bug hinges on."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"compile_tree","line":1044,"var":"OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST","code":"else if (emptiness == BODY_MAY_BE_EMPTY_MEM) { ... add_op(reg, OP_EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST); }","note":"Compilation emits the empty-check bytecode variant that consults memory-state bookkeeping during matching."},
{"step":7,"file":"oniguruma/src/regexec.c","function":"EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST","line":2063,"var":"STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM","code":"CASE_OP(EMPTY_CHECK_END_MEMST) { STACK_EMPTY_CHECK_MEM(is_empty, mem, s, reg); ... }","note":"At runtime, the matcher reads the empty-check bookkeeping and traverses stack memory that can be stale in the vulnerable scenario."},
{"step":8,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"mb_ereg execution","line":None,"var":"match","code":"mb_ereg('(?:()|())*\\2', '') executes the compiled regex against the empty subject.","note":"This is the sink: the compiled empty-repeat/backreference pattern is executed and can surface the heap-use-after-free read."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
